msg: Gnomes appear in fixed pairs (positions can vary):- orange and brown- green and pink- red and yellow- blue and purpleeach gnome within pair leads to different forest- orange, green, red, blue -> bright forest with red basket- brown, pink, yellow and purple-> dark forestreach forest with most mushrooms - but number changes constantlyuse information from above regarding link between gnomes and forests to get different forests and track how much mushrooms you can get - always go for forest with most mushrooms
